title: How to Set Up AI Email Replies in a HubSpot Shared Inbox
summary: Connect HubSpot team email to Quickchat AI. Follow a real reply from Sent to Spam, then test Cc routing and a five-minute human handoff in your shared inbox.
body_markdown:
**Quickchat AI** answered a customer’s email from Beacon Bench’s **HubSpot shared inbox** . The customer wanted to know how long the workshop would hold a repaired lamp and what to bring for pickup.


HubSpot marked Beacon Bot’s reply **Sent** at 23:03. At 23:04, Apple Mail showed **Re: \[Beacon A2\] Lamp pickup** in **All Junk** . The reply gave the customer 10 calendar days from the shop’s ready-for-collection email and told them to bring the repair reference.


Read the email the customer received


Piotr played the customer in this test. The sender name, reply subject and pickup instructions are visible in his mailbox.


[Full-size screenshot](https://quickchat.ai/assets/blog/posts/hubspot-shared-inbox-ai-email-replies/hubspot-email-a2-received.webp)


You can reproduce that result with one external test mailbox and a HubSpot-hosted team address. Once a direct reply arrives, try copying a colleague or giving a teammate five minutes to answer first. If your channel is already connected, jump tothe direct email test ,the To and Cc comparison orthe missing-email checks .[Download the English test emails and receipt sheet](https://quickchat.ai/blog-assets/downloads/hubspot-team-email-test.txt) .


## 1. What should the Agent say when a customer asks about pickup?


Start with the answer. Beacon gives customers **10 calendar days after the shop sends the ready-for-collection email** . They need the **repair reference from that email** when they collect the lamp. “Ten days after the repair” sounds close, but it starts the clock at a different event.


1. Open your demo Agent in Quickchat AI. If you followed our bilingual HubSpot guide, open **Beacon Bench Support → Knowledge Base** and select **Collecting a repaired lamp** . The existing article and HubSpot connection work for this tutorial.[See how we set up Beacon’s Agent and pickup page](https://quickchat.ai/post/hubspot-chatbot-knowledge-base#pickup-source) .
2. Starting fresh? Sign in to Quickchat AI, create an Agent with **Set up manually** , and give it a recognizable name in **Identity** . Open **Knowledge Base → Add Article** and title it **Collecting a repaired lamp** . Paste the two sentences below, save, and wait for **Ready** .[Create a Quickchat AI account](https://app.quickchat.ai/register)


> Beacon Bench holds your repaired lamp for 10 calendar days after we send the ready-for-collection email.
>
>
> Bring the repair reference from your email when you collect your lamp.


Read the pickup policy up close


Beacon’s article after the policy update. Read the two sentences in the editor before you test another channel.


[Full-size screenshot](https://quickchat.ai/assets/blog/posts/hubspot-shared-inbox-ai-email-replies/quickchat-email-pickup-policy.webp)


1. In **AI Preview** , ask **How many calendar days do I have to collect my repaired lamp, and what should I bring?** Check the number, the starting event and the repair reference. If any detail is missing, open the saved article before testing email. To check the wording again after a policy change, save[Beacon’s three pickup questions](https://quickchat.ai/post/hubspot-chatbot-knowledge-base#refresh-the-policy) under **Conversations → Testing → Create Dataset** and review the credit cost before starting a run.


Already managing Quickchat AI from ChatGPT or Claude? Connect your account and ask: *“Open my Beacon Bench Support Agent. Read back its pickup article and tell me when the ten days start, what the customer should bring and which channels are connected.”* You can check the answer there, then choose how Support receives email in HubSpot.[Quickchat AI for ChatGPT](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6a4656c688748191be4c5247fb0d5dfc) ·[Quickchat AI for Claude](https://claude.ai/directory/connectors/app-quickchat-ai) ·[Manage Quickchat AI from an AI app](https://quickchat.ai/docs/manage-with-ai)


## 2. How do you connect a team email to a HubSpot shared inbox?


HubSpot can generate the workshop’s practice address. Riley, our example customer, writes to it from an ordinary email app. For the direct test you need one mailbox separate from the team address and Beacon Bot’s login. Add Casey’s mailbox only if you want to test Cc.


Name in the example Where you use it


**Support** The HubSpot-hosted address for this exercise. If you already connected a dedicated team mailbox, use that address for all three To/Cc tests.


**Beacon Bot** A dedicated HubSpot user with access to the inbox. Routing selects this user as the conversation owner.


**Piotr** The teammate who configures the channel and takes over one thread.


**Riley and Casey** Riley sends the question and Casey checks the copy. Both use their own email apps. Neither mailbox needs a HubSpot connection.


**Give the two HubSpot users access.** Starting with an empty portal? As the administrator, open **Settings → Users & Teams** , invite a second user at a separate address you control, and have that user accept the invitation. Under **Seats** , check that the person configuring automatic routing and each user receiving routed conversations have an assigned Sales Seat or Service Seat. Open **Settings → Inbox & Help Desk → Inboxes** and give the dedicated user and the teammate access to the same General inbox. You can use the default inbox. Beacon already has one called **Beacon Bench Support** .[Walk through the account, seats and inbox with screenshots](https://quickchat.ai/post/hubspot-chatbot-knowledge-base#route-live-chat) ·[HubSpot’s routing requirements](https://knowledge.hubspot.com/inbox/set-your-conversations-routing-rules)


Enlarge the Seat field


Our portal offered a Service Enterprise trial seat when we invited Beacon Bot. Check the seat assigned to your own routing user.


[Full-size screenshot](https://quickchat.ai/assets/blog/posts/hubspot-shared-inbox-ai-email-replies/hubspot-service-seat.webp)


Quickchat AI includes HubSpot on its self-serve plans. The Free plan is for personal, non-commercial use. Check the seats in your portal before buying anything for the exercise. Beacon reused the **developer test account** from the pickup tutorial. If you’re using a **standard sandbox** , choose recipient addresses that belong to sandbox users for the one-to-one email test.[Quickchat AI plans](https://quickchat.ai/pricing) ·[HubSpot account types](https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/getting-started/account-types#developer-test-accounts) ·[Standard sandbox email limits](https://knowledge.hubspot.com/account-management/deploy-sandbox-changes-to-production)


**Connect the mailbox where Support receives mail.**


1. Sign in to the practice portal as the human operator with **Account Access** . Open **Settings → Inbox & Help Desk → Channels** . Under **Team channels** , click **Team Email** . Beacon’s tile showed **3 email addresses** the first time we opened this page.


Enlarge the Team Email tile


Click Team Email in the row below Chat and Form to see which addresses HubSpot is counting.


[Full-size screenshot](https://quickchat.ai/assets/blog/posts/hubspot-shared-inbox-ai-email-replies/hubspot-team-channels-overview.webp)


1. Read **Routing To** beside each address. If your practice mailbox is already connected to the right inbox, open its row and continue tothe routing settings . Beacon had three fallback addresses, each marked **Turned off for sending** . The bottom row led to **Beacon Bench Support** . This badge describes outbound sending from the fallback. HubSpot configures incoming forwarding separately. To add the address customers will write to, click **Connect email address** at the upper right.[HubSpot’s fallback email settings](https://knowledge.hubspot.com/inbox/set-up-the-conversations-inbox#edit-the-fallback-email-address)


Enlarge the connect button and the workshop’s fallback status


The first two rows lead to Inbox and Help Desk. The third shows the destination to choose for the workshop mailbox.


[Full-size screenshot](https://quickchat.ai/assets/blog/posts/hubspot-shared-inbox-ai-email-replies/hubspot-team-email-address-list.webp)


1. On **Choose destination** , open **Send incoming conversations to** . Beacon’s portal initially showed **Help Desk** . Select **Beacon Bench Support** or the General inbox you prepared. The card below changes to **Inbox** and explains that incoming messages will appear there. Click **Next** .


Enlarge the destination field


The Inbox card confirms where Riley’s email will appear. You’ll choose its owner later under Set up assignment.


[Full-size screenshot](https://quickchat.ai/assets/blog/posts/hubspot-shared-inbox-ai-email-replies/hubspot-team-email-destination.webp)


**If your portal opens on Inboxes** , choose your inbox in **Current view** , then click **Connect a channel → Team email** . This version opens the provider setup from the inbox itself.


Enlarge the Team email tile


In the General inbox chooser, Team email opens mailbox setup. Chat opens the website widget setup.


[Full-size screenshot](https://quickchat.ai/assets/blog/posts/hubspot-shared-inbox-ai-email-replies/hubspot-team-email-choice.webp)


1. Open **Choose email provider** . Pick the option that matches how you want the workshop to receive mail.


Enlarge the three provider choices


Other opens HubSpot’s hosted email setup. Simply opening this menu leaves your mailboxes unconnected.


[Full-size screenshot](https://quickchat.ai/assets/blog/posts/hubspot-shared-inbox-ai-email-replies/hubspot-team-email-provider.webp)


- **To try the hosted channel, choose Other.** HubSpot generates an address you can email directly. Later, a support alias, Google Group or Microsoft 365 shared mailbox can forward mail to it.
- **For a direct connection, choose Gmail or Outlook365** (Microsoft 365). Sign in with a dedicated practice mailbox and review the provider’s permissions. HubSpot can receive and send through that account. New incoming emails appear in the shared inbox, where people with access can read them and authorized teammates can reply. Earlier messages do not appear in Conversations. Disconnecting later leaves contact records and email activity already logged in HubSpot.[HubSpot’s team email guide](https://knowledge.hubspot.com/inbox/connect-channels-to-the-conversations-inbox) ·[What disconnecting removes](https://knowledge.hubspot.com/connected-email/disconnect-your-inbox-from-hubspot)


**If HubSpot asks for your email provider a second time** , leave the upper menu on **Other** . The lower menu, **Choose your email provider** , opens instructions for setting up forwarding. Select **Google Groups** if that’s where your support address lives. For general instructions, scroll inside the menu past **Comcast** and select **Other** . Opening those instructions grants no access to your mailbox.


Enlarge the forwarding instructions menu


In Beacon’s portal the lower menu opens upward. Scroll within the list to reach Other just below Comcast.


[Full-size screenshot](https://quickchat.ai/assets/blog/posts/hubspot-shared-inbox-ai-email-replies/hubspot-hosted-forwarding-menus.webp)


Click **Copy** beside **Copy your forwarding address** and keep the address for Riley’s first email. Click **Next** to open **Customize details** . You can complete this test without changing a mailbox or forwarding rule.


If customers already write to a support alias, configure its provider to forward mail for that alias to the generated address. Complete any verification the provider requests. Then repeat the To/Cc comparison through the address customers actually use, because forwarding can change which recipients HubSpot sees.[HubSpot’s hosted email and forwarding instructions](https://knowledge.hubspot.com/inbox/connect-a-hosted-email-to-your-conversations-inbox)


1. On **Customize your email name and signature** , keep **From name** set to **Agent and company name** . In the empty field after **from** , type **Beacon Bench** . HubSpot supplies the sending user’s name. Later, when Riley compares two replies, the sender line will help distinguish the Agent from the teammate who took over.


Enlarge the sender settings


Piotr is signed in, so his name appears beside the workshop’s in the preview. The next screen chooses who will handle incoming conversations.


[Full-size screenshot](https://quickchat.ai/assets/blog/posts/hubspot-shared-inbox-ai-email-replies/hubspot-hosted-sender-details.webp)


Under **From address** , leave **Use default** selected to send through HubSpot’s hosted address. Scroll down to **Team signature** and leave it empty for this exercise. Click **Next** to open **Set up assignment** .


1. On **Set up assignment** , open **Assign conversations** . Beacon’s channel starts at **No owner** . Choose **Specific users and teams** , immediately above **Use assignment workflow** . If you see **Contact owner** near the bottom, scroll up inside the open menu. The gray **AI agent** option is for HubSpot’s built-in agent. Quickchat AI answers through the HubSpot user you created for it.


Enlarge the assignment choices


Choose the row that says it assigns a conversation to a user from the selected group. HubSpot’s gray AI agent can stay unconfigured.


[Full-size screenshot](https://quickchat.ai/assets/blog/posts/hubspot-shared-inbox-ai-email-replies/hubspot-email-assignment-options.webp)


1. Click **Add a user** . Under **User** , check only **Beacon Bot** , then close the picker. HubSpot enables **Next** once a user is selected. Leave **Distribution** on **Load Balanced** . With only Beacon Bot selected, every eligible conversation has the same intended owner. If the user is missing from the list, check its inbox access and its assigned Sales or Service seat.


Enlarge the user picker and availability rule


Leave the human teammate unchecked. They can still take a conversation manually after it arrives.


[Full-size screenshot](https://quickchat.ai/assets/blog/posts/hubspot-shared-inbox-ai-email-replies/hubspot-email-beacon-bot-assignment.webp)


Beacon kept **Assign to available users only** checked. If the bot is away, a new conversation stays unassigned. A teammate with the right permission can open **Settings → Inbox & Help Desk → Availability Management** , click the status in Beacon Bot’s row and choose **Available** .[HubSpot’s inbox availability settings](https://knowledge.hubspot.com/inbox/manage-your-inbox-users)


1. Click **Next** . HubSpot shows **Email connected** and **Routes to → Inbox as Conversations** . Click **Close** to return to **Team Email** . Find the new row by its display name, **Beacon Bench** . Check its **Routing To** column and that **Sync Status** is on. In our portal this was the fourth row, below the three fallback addresses.


Read the connection confirmation and the new channel row


The confirmation names the destination type. The new row shows which inbox receives this channel’s conversations.


[Full-size screenshot](https://quickchat.ai/assets/blog/posts/hubspot-shared-inbox-ai-email-replies/hubspot-email-connected-channel.webp)


**If your wizard shows an assignment switch** , turn on **Automatically assign conversations** and choose the same user under **Assign to → Specific users and teams** . For an existing channel, open **Settings → Inbox & Help Desk → Channels → Team Email** , select the connected address and choose **Routing → Edit routing** . In the older **Inboxes** view, hover over the channel and choose **Edit → Automation → Assign to** . The chatflow has its own assignment settings.[HubSpot’s channel settings](https://knowledge.hubspot.com/help-desk/connect-and-manage-inbox-and-help-desk-channels)


## 3. Which HubSpot email address goes into Quickchat AI?


Use the **dedicated HubSpot user’s login email** . The team address receives mail. The user’s login identifies which HubSpot owner the Agent answers for.


1. In your Agent, open **External Apps → HubSpot** . On a new connection, enter the dedicated login under **HubSpot User Email** , then select **Connect with HubSpot** . Choose the portal that owns the team inbox. A HubSpot Super Admin or a user with App Marketplace access and the permissions requested by the app can authorize it. If the same Agent already shows **Connected** , open **Settings** .[See the original HubSpot installation walkthrough](https://quickchat.ai/post/create-ai-chatbot-for-hubspot)
2. Turn on **Enable HubSpot** . Set **Delay every email reply** to **No delay** and save. Leave the optional email resolution survey off for the exercise so its follow-up can’t be mistaken for an answer.[Quickchat AI’s HubSpot setup guide](https://quickchat.ai/docs/channels/hubspot)


Enlarge the email settings


Beacon’s saved setup for the direct and copied tests. You’ll return to this panel to set the five-minute delay.


[Full-size screenshot](https://quickchat.ai/assets/blog/posts/hubspot-shared-inbox-ai-email-replies/quickchat-hubspot-email-settings.webp)


1. In **HubSpot → CRM → Inbox** , pick **Beacon Bench Support** from the inbox menu at the top left. As the human teammate, choose **All open** in the left sidebar so you can see threads assigned to Beacon Bot. Keep that window open alongside the mailbox you’ll send from.


### What happened when HubSpot sent its sample email?


Our first thread came from **Maria Johnson (Sample Contact)** . HubSpot sent an assignment notification and included an address under **Send yourself a test email using** . The sample reached the connected Agent. In Quickchat AI’s Inbox we found its answer, “How can I help you with your lamp repair?” A second HubSpot notice, **Unable to send email** , reported a failed send to Maria’s sample address. It gave no cause.


Read the sample message and failed-send notice


Copy the test address from the assignment email for Riley’s message. The second notice concerns the send to Maria’s sample address.


[Full-size screenshot](https://quickchat.ai/assets/blog/posts/hubspot-shared-inbox-ai-email-replies/hubspot-sample-email-notifications-full.webp)


Look for that assignment notification in the mailbox where you receive HubSpot alerts. Beacon’s CRM inbox also had an older Maria thread labeled **Live Chat** , with a prompt to send a test chat. The hosted email address was in the **Email** card in the notification. **No Owner** on its **Contact** card describes Maria’s CRM record. To see who handles an incoming message, open the email thread in **CRM → Inbox** and read the **Owner** above it.[HubSpot’s conversations inbox guide](https://knowledge.hubspot.com/inbox/use-the-conversations-inbox)


## 4. How do you check that the AI reply reached the customer?


1.


In Riley’s usual email app, choose **Compose** . Put the team address from HubSpot in **To** and leave **Cc** and **Bcc** empty. Use the subject **\[Beacon A2\] Lamp pickup** so you can find the same message in both apps. Ask the workshop about pickup.


> How many calendar days do I have to collect my repaired lamp, and what should I bring?


2.


In **HubSpot → CRM → Inbox** , select the inbox connected to the team address, choose **All open** and open the email with that subject. The **Owner** above the conversation tells you who handles it. Click the sender’s name in the right-hand panel to open their contact record. Under **Activities** , expand the outgoing **Re: \[Beacon A2\] Lamp pickup** entry. Ours showed **Beacon Bot** and a green **Sent** at 23:03 Warsaw time.


Enlarge Beacon Bot’s sent activity


On the customer’s contact record, expand the outgoing email to see the author, status and answer together. HubSpot displays this time as 11:03 PM GMT+1.


[Full-size screenshot](https://quickchat.ai/assets/blog/posts/hubspot-shared-inbox-ai-email-replies/hubspot-email-a2-crm-sent.webp)


1. Return to the mailbox you sent from and search for **Re: \[Beacon A2\] Lamp pickup** . Check **Spam** or **Junk** as well as the inbox. In our test, the staff notification **New Email conversation assigned to you** arrived at 23:03. The customer’s email appeared in Apple Mail’s **All Junk** at 23:04, from **Beacon Bot from Beacon Bench** .
2. Open the reply. Look for the pickup window, when it starts and what to bring. The message we received gave **10 calendar days after the shop sends the ready-for-collection email** and asked us to **bring the repair reference from that email** . The assignment notification goes to the HubSpot user handling the conversation.


### Does the Agent answer when Support is only on Cc?


Riley might ask Casey to collect the lamp and copy the shop just to keep it informed. With a known team address, Quickchat AI checks the **To** field on the latest incoming email before answering. If your team relies on that distinction, try it with two test mailboxes. The diagram shows what to look for with two recipients. The reply pictured above came from our single-recipient test.


What to expect when you move Support from To to Cc **Support is addressed**


ToSupportCcCasey


Riley gets a policy reply. Casey is copied.


**Support is copied**


ToCaseyCcSupport


The shop receives the thread and stays silent.


Keep the same question and Support address throughout. Start each row as a new message.


New subject To Cc What to look for


**\[Beacon A\] Lamp pickup** Support Casey A policy reply addressed to Riley, with Casey copied.


**\[Beacon B\] Lamp pickup** Casey Support The inbound email in HubSpot. Check both external inboxes for a reply during the next ten minutes.


**\[Beacon C\] Lamp pickup** Support Casey A second direct reply. This tells you the channel could still send after B.


**For A, add Casey in Cc.** Keep Support in **To** and send. In HubSpot’s **All open** view, look for **\[Beacon A\] Lamp pickup** beside an envelope icon. If an older chat is still open in the middle pane, click the new email row. You can also find it using the search icon at the top left. Read **Owner** above the message. Ours showed **Beacon Bot** even while the separate **Contact owner** field on the right still showed **No owner** .


Compare the original To and Cc with the incoming HubSpot thread


Riley and Casey are the sender and copied recipient in our example. Here you can see Piotr running the test. HubSpot recorded the email arriving and the thread being assigned to Beacon Bot at 14:58 Warsaw time.


[Full-size screenshot](https://quickchat.ai/assets/blog/posts/hubspot-shared-inbox-ai-email-replies/hubspot-email-lamp-arrival.webp)


Our first attempt with a colleague in Cc produced the correct answer, but HubSpot marked the outgoing reply **Not delivered** . The warning on the contact record identified the address we had copied. The later A2 email reached the original sender on its own.See the failed reply and the warning that identified the recipient .


When your A reply arrives, open **Re: \[Beacon A\] Lamp pickup** in Riley’s mailbox and expand the sender details. Check that Riley is in **To** , Casey is in **Cc** , and the answer gives the pickup window, its starting event and the repair reference. In Casey’s mailbox, look for **Beacon Bot’s reply** . Casey will also have Riley’s original question if that copy arrived. If either person is missing the reply, check Spam or Junk in that mailbox before continuing.


**Once a direct reply reaches both mailboxes, run B and C with that same pair.** For B, open the inbound details in HubSpot to confirm Support was copied and **Beacon Bot** owns the thread. Record its arrival time. Send C as a fresh message while you watch B and check that the same user owns C. If C succeeds and neither mailbox receives an AI reply to B in ten minutes, you’ve isolated the change in address placement. If an owner differs or either direct reply fails, investigate that thread before interpreting B.


**What happens on a longer thread?** The original requester remains the main recipient. The integration builds the copy list from eligible senders and To/Cc recipients on the **latest inbound email** . It removes duplicates and excludes the team mailbox and dedicated user’s own addresses. Earlier copied names do not necessarily carry into the next reply. If HubSpot cannot supply the team address, the Cc-only check can let a message through. If the address is still unknown when sending, Quickchat omits Cc. Repeat the test with any forwarding address you plan to use.


## 5. How can a teammate take over before a delayed AI email goes out?


To try a human handoff in your own inbox, give Piotr one conversation and leave another with Beacon Bot. Riley will ask the same two questions in each. The difference is who owns the thread when Quickchat comes to send the answer.


1. In **Quickchat AI → External Apps → HubSpot → Settings** , set **Delay every email reply** to **5 minutes** . Save, reopen the setting, and check the value. It applies to the Agent’s HubSpot email, so do this on your practice setup.
2. From Riley, compose **\[Beacon D\] Lamp pickup** to Support. In a second new email, compose **\[Beacon E\] Lamp pickup** to Support. Send the same opening line in both: **When does the pickup window for my repaired lamp start?**
3. Within one minute of each first message, reply in that same thread, keeping Support in **To** : **One more thing: which reference should I bring?** The second message can join the first answer. It doesn’t restart the five-minute clock.
4. **Take D.** In **HubSpot → CRM → Inbox** , open **\[Beacon D\]** . Before the five minutes elapse, change the conversation’s **Owner** from **Beacon Bot** to your own name. Choose the customer-facing **Email** reply, write **I’m picking this up for the workshop. Please bring the repair reference from your ready email.** and send. An internal comment is visible to your team only.
5. **Leave E with Beacon Bot.** Read both threads in Riley’s mailbox ten minutes after their respective first arrivals. Look for Piotr’s message alone on D and one AI answer covering both questions on E. The hold starts when Quickchat receives the first eligible message. After five minutes the answer can be processed and sent. Record when it actually arrives.


Run both threads on the same settings. E shows what the Agent does with the follow-up while D gives Piotr time to reply.


The important control is **Owner above the conversation** . Changing an associated ticket owner or typing an internal note doesn’t transfer the email thread. When a person owns it before the held answer is processed, Quickchat skips the AI reply. Once you’ve finished, restore your preferred delay.[See how conversation owner and ticket owner appear in Beacon’s inbox](https://quickchat.ai/post/hubspot-chatbot-knowledge-base#human-handoff) .


Enlarge the Owner menu


The Owner menu in Beacon’s earlier live chat. Open the same control above your email conversation, then send your reply using Email.


[Full-size screenshot](https://quickchat.ai/assets/blog/posts/hubspot-chatbot-knowledge-base/hubspot-context-conversation-owner.webp)


## Where should you look if a support email goes missing?


**If the activity says Sent, check the customer’s folders.** Search for the exact subject in the mailbox that sent the question. In Gmail, try` in:anywhere subject:"\[Beacon A2\] Lamp pickup"` to include Spam and Trash. Open the result from the team sender and compare the answer with the outgoing HubSpot activity. We found ours in Junk. The mailbox shows where it landed, but it gives no reason for that placement.[Gmail’s search operators](https://support.google.com/mail/answer/7190?hl=en)


**If HubSpot marks the reply Not delivered, open the outgoing activity.** Click **View email** in the **Unable to send email** notice. Our earlier test with Casey in Cc looked like this. The staff notification named the original sender and the inbox showed the failed reply.


Read Beacon Bot’s answer, the delivery status and the failure notice


The earlier \[Beacon A\] test with Casey in Cc. HubSpot recorded the policy answer, then marked the reply Not delivered.


[Full-size screenshot](https://quickchat.ai/assets/blog/posts/hubspot-shared-inbox-ai-email-replies/hubspot-email-lamp-reply-status.webp)


To find the address HubSpot flagged, open the original sender’s contact record. The activity is still available after the conversation is closed.


1. In the thread, click the original sender’s name at the top of the right-hand contact panel.
2. On the CRM record, select **Activities** , then **Emails** . Expand the outgoing **Re: \[Beacon A\] Lamp pickup** entry. The incoming question appears separately below it.
3. Read the warning above the reply body and compare the named address with the **To** and **Cc** fields in your original sent message. In Beacon’s test, it matched the address Riley had put in **Cc** . HubSpot said that address had previously bounced, reported a message as spam or unsubscribed. The warning did not specify which applied.[HubSpot contact activity filters](https://knowledge.hubspot.com/records/filter-activities-on-a-record-timeline#use-the-activities-tab)


Enlarge the warning on the outgoing email


We opened the contact record for the person in To. The warning on the 14:58 outgoing reply identified the person we had copied.


[Full-size screenshot](https://quickchat.ai/assets/blog/posts/hubspot-shared-inbox-ai-email-replies/hubspot-email-recipient-delivery-issue.webp)


**If HubSpot flags the copied address, test one recipient first.** For one-to-one email, HubSpot says that a previous bounce for any recipient can block the send to everyone. Here’s how to check what the team address can deliver while leaving the flagged contact’s email preferences alone.[HubSpot’s guide to email send errors](https://knowledge.hubspot.com/marketing-email/email-error-when-sending-to-contact)


Use thesingle-recipient test to check direct delivery. That is how we got the A2 reply shown at the top. To retry the copy, use a fresh subject such as **\[Beacon A3\] Lamp pickup** and a different test mailbox you control or whose owner agreed to participate. Once you find the policy answer in both mailboxes, use that same pair forB and C .


What you see Where to check next


Riley sent A, but HubSpot has no thread. Check the new channel’s address, Routing To and Sync Status. Search for the exact subject in the destination inbox, including closed conversations. If you sent through a support alias, check its forwarding rule.


The thread is there, but nobody answered. Check its conversation Owner, the dedicated user’s availability, the channel’s routing and the saved delay. Use a new message from a person for the next test. Recognized out-of-office replies, bounce notices and no-reply senders can be skipped.


Riley received an acknowledgement immediately. Expand its sender and read the body. Keep looking for the message that answers the lamp question, then compare that message with the outbound entry in HubSpot.


HubSpot shows an outbound reply, but Casey has no copy. Open its full headers in Riley’s mailbox and check the latest inbound message. If Casey is listed, check Casey’s spam and filtering. If Casey is absent, verify the connected address and inspect the To/Cc on that inbound message.


Replace the lamp policy with one question customers ask your own team. Send it from an outside mailbox and read the answer the way a customer would. Keep that subject and answer as a quick check the next time you change the support address or forwarding rule. If your team also works in Intercom, follow its[support email walkthrough](https://quickchat.ai/post/intercom-support-email-ai-replies) .


## Frequently asked questions


### How do I set up AI replies for a HubSpot shared inbox?


Connect a Team Email channel to a HubSpot Conversations Inbox, choose Specific users and teams in its routing, and select the dedicated HubSpot user. In Quickchat AI, connect the same portal using that user’s login email and enable HubSpot. Send a fresh question directly to the team address and check the conversation owner in HubSpot. Look for the policy answer in the sender’s mailbox, including Spam or Junk.


### What’s the difference between a HubSpot team email and a personal email?


A team email brings new incoming messages into a shared HubSpot inbox. People with access can read them, and users with sending permission can reply from the team address. Earlier messages do not appear in Conversations. A personal email connection belongs to one user. HubSpot requires separate addresses for those two connections.


### Can I test HubSpot team email without connecting my personal Gmail or Outlook inbox?


Yes. Choose Other to create a HubSpot-hosted address. After connecting the channel, send a fresh message directly to the generated address from your usual email app. Beacon’s assignment notification included the test address. Set up forwarding only if you want HubSpot to receive mail addressed to an existing support alias.


### Why does my HubSpot fallback email say “Turned off for sending”?


HubSpot provides a fallback address for the inbox. This badge means sending from that address is switched off. Incoming forwarding has a separate setting. In Team Email, check Routing To to find your practice inbox. To use the mailbox customers write to, click Connect email address, select that inbox and connect the mailbox.


### How do I show who sent a reply from a HubSpot-hosted team email?


In Customize details, set From name to Agent and company name. Enter your company name beside the Agent name chip. HubSpot displays the sending user’s name alongside the company name. You can keep the default From address and leave the team signature empty. In Set up assignment, choose who handles incoming conversations.


### Why does HubSpot say “AI agent is not set up yet” when I’m connecting Quickchat AI?


That message refers to HubSpot’s built-in AI agent. Quickchat AI answers through a dedicated HubSpot user. In Set up assignment, open Assign conversations, choose Specific users and teams, and select only the dedicated user. Use that user’s login email in the HubSpot User Email field in Quickchat AI. After setup, check the Owner of a new incoming email to confirm the routing.


### Why did I get an “Unable to send email” notice for Maria Johnson (Sample Contact) after connecting HubSpot?


In Beacon’s portal, HubSpot created a sample conversation when the channel connected. Quickchat AI received it and generated a reply. HubSpot then reported that sending to the sample address failed. The notice gives no cause. Choose View email to inspect the message, then send a fresh question to the hosted address from a mailbox you control to check real delivery.


### Why does HubSpot say Sent when the customer can’t find the AI reply?


Search the recipient’s mailbox for the reply subject, including Spam or Junk. Match the sender name and answer with the outgoing email on the original sender’s HubSpot contact record. In our test, HubSpot showed Sent at 23:03 and Apple Mail showed the policy reply in All Junk at 23:04. The separate assignment notification went to the HubSpot user.


### Why does my HubSpot inbox show an AI reply marked “Not delivered”?


Open View email in the failure notice and match the subject and time to the outgoing reply. On the original sender’s contact record, select Activities, then Emails, and expand the outgoing reply. In our test the notice named the sender, while the warning on the activity identified the address we had put in Cc.


### Can one Cc address stop a HubSpot email from reaching the person in To?


Yes. HubSpot documents that a one-to-one email with several recipients is blocked for everyone if any recipient previously bounced. Our warning listed a previous bounce, a spam complaint or an unsubscribe for the copied address without saying which applied. To check direct delivery, send a fresh test to the team address with Cc and Bcc empty and look for the answer in the sender’s mailbox.


### Which email goes in the HubSpot User Email field in Quickchat AI?


Enter the login email for the dedicated HubSpot user selected in the team email channel’s routing. The customer sends to the shared team address. The two addresses have different jobs: one receives the message and the other identifies the HubSpot conversation owner.


### Which HubSpot permissions and seats do I need for email routing?


Connecting the team channel requires Account Access. The person editing automatic routing and each user selected to receive routed conversations need an assigned Sales Seat or Service Seat. Give the dedicated user access to the destination inbox, and check availability if your rule assigns only to available users.


### Can I connect a Google Group or Microsoft 365 shared mailbox to HubSpot?


Yes. For a Google Group, a Microsoft 365 shared mailbox or an alias, choose Other in the team email setup and follow HubSpot’s hosted forwarding instructions. A forwarded message can present different recipients to HubSpot. Test both a direct and a copied message through the exact public address customers will use.


### Will AI reply if my HubSpot support address is only on Cc?


When HubSpot supplies the connected team address, Quickchat AI checks the latest inbound email and answers only if that address appears in To. When the address lookup fails, a Cc-only message can still proceed. Test this in two mailboxes, with a successful direct message before and after the copied-only thread.


### Who receives the AI reply when a customer copies a colleague?


The original requester stays in To. With a known team address, Quickchat AI copies eligible additional people from the latest inbound sender, To and Cc fields, removes duplicates and excludes the team address. It does not add Bcc recipients. If the team address is still unknown at send time, the reply omits Cc.


### Does a HubSpot out-of-office email trigger another AI reply?


Quickchat AI skips messages it recognizes as automated, including familiar out-of-office replies, delivery failures and no-reply senders. Use a fresh message written from a person’s test mailbox to check delivery. If you receive a canned acknowledgement, look for a separate reply that actually answers the question.


### Can a teammate stop a delayed AI email reply in HubSpot?


Yes. Set Delay every email reply in Quickchat AI’s HubSpot settings. Before the held reply is processed, open the HubSpot inbox thread and transfer its conversation Owner to the teammate. The teammate can now use Email to reply to the customer. Changing an associated ticket owner or adding an internal comment does not transfer the conversation.


### Does a follow-up email restart the AI reply delay?


A second eligible inbound email in the same thread can join the held reply. The deadline is set by the first inbound email. Five minutes makes the answer eligible for processing at that point. Record arrival in the recipient’s mailbox to measure the delivery time the customer actually experiences.


### Can a HubSpot sandbox send the test replies to external addresses?


HubSpot restricts one-to-one email in a standard sandbox to addresses belonging to its users. Beacon used a developer test account, for which HubSpot documents a marketing email restriction. If a Conversations Inbox reply shows Not delivered, check the reason on that email’s activity before attributing the failure to an account limit.
